flora: Dried/fossilized leaf (shale-grey, flattened, showing preserved outline)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; leathery, waxy leaf surfaces; chunky fibrous stems; rounded, safe-looking frond tips; high-specular highlights to suggest humidity.

visual_logic.composition: Tiled composition: Top-Left: A tightly curled new frond; Top-Right: A wide shot of a full fan-leaf; Bottom-Left: The textured base where the leaf meets the trunk; Bottom-Right: A leaf impression in a slab of grey Karabastau shale.
visual_logic.ground: Olive-tinted silty mud with small, smooth river-worn pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even illumination to distinguish the green living tissue from the grey fossilized tissue.
